units.source_text: 这天晚上，就寝诵经之前，为了特地祷告天皇陛下安康，悼念阵亡者之灵，诵了很长的经。

en.t: That evening, before the bedtime sutra chanting, they recited a long sutra in order to pray especially for the health of His Majesty the Emperor and to mourn the spirits of those who had fallen in battle.

units.source_text: 战争以来，佛门各宗都穿着简朴的圆口袈裟，可今夜，尤其是老师穿上了收藏多年的红色五幅布袈裟。

en.t: Since the war began, all the Buddhist sects had worn plain round-collared robes, but tonight the master in particular put on a red five-panel robe that had been stored away for many years.
